purpose: Assigns every current player a unique replicated `uint8` ID. Automatic IDs use the compact `1..Players.MaxPlayers` range, remain stable for the player's session, and are recycled after departure. Zero is intentionally left available as an unassigned network sentinel.
description: Assigns every current player a unique replicated `uint8` ID. Automatic IDs use the compact `1..Players.MaxPlayers` range, remain stable for the player's session, and are recycled after departure. Zero is intentionally left available as an unassigned network sentinel.

PlayerIdServiceClient.luau.description: Client mirror for reading and observing server-assigned uint8 player IDs. Public entry points include `PlayerIdServiceClient.Init`, `PlayerIdServiceClient.GetId`, `PlayerIdServiceClient.Observe`, `PlayerIdServiceClient.Destroy`.

Shared/PlayerIdServiceInterface.luau.description: Realm-aware Tie contract implemented on the Players service. Shared implementations expose ID reads and observation. Only the server realm can refresh or author assignments.

Shared/PlayerIdServiceUtils.luau.description: Validated access to the replicated uint8 player identifier. Public entry points include `PlayerIdServiceUtils.isPlayerId`, `PlayerIdServiceUtils.getId`, `PlayerIdServiceUtils.getPlayerFromId`, `PlayerIdServiceUtils.observeId`.
